a.en: Try another source: on the player, open Sources and pick the next one. The first source can be down while others work.
a.hi: Doosra source try karo: player me Sources kholo aur agla chuno. Pehla source down ho sakta hai, baaki chalte hain.

a.en: Tap the quality icon and choose a lower option, or switch source. Slow internet also buffers at high quality.
a.hi: Quality icon dabao aur kam quality chuno, ya source badlo. Slow internet pe high quality buffering karti hai.

a.en: This title may not be available yet. Check the spelling in Search, or try the same title a bit later — sources come and go.
a.hi: Ye title abhi available nahi ho sakta. Search me spelling check karo, ya thodi der baad try karo — sources aate-jaate hain.

a.en: Check free storage: Downloads stop when the phone is nearly full. Also make sure Wi-Fi is on — downloads pause on mobile data by default.
a.hi: Storage khaali hai ya nahi dekho: phone bhara ho to download ruk jaata hai. Wi-Fi on rakho — mobile data pe download by default rukta hai.

a.en: Downloads pause on mobile data. Open Settings and turn on "Download on mobile data", or switch to Wi-Fi.
a.hi: Mobile data pe download rukta hai. Settings me "Download on mobile data" on karo, ya Wi-Fi pe aao.

a.en: Tap the player once and use the volume gesture on the right side, or your device volume. Also check the audio track in the player menu.
a.hi: Player pe ek baar tap karo aur right side pe volume gesture use karo, ya phone ka volume. Player menu me audio track bhi dekho.

a.en: Open the player menu and pick Subtitles, then choose a language. If the list is empty, this source has no subtitle file — try another source.
a.hi: Player menu me Subtitles kholo aur language chuno. List khaali ho to is source me subtitle file nahi hai — doosra source try karo.

a.en: Set your audio language in Settings → Playback → Audio language. The app then prefers Hindi-dub sources automatically.
a.hi: Settings → Playback → Audio language me apni language set karo. App phir Hindi-dub sources ko automatically prefer karega.

a.en: Update to the latest version — older builds lost the name after restart. On the new version your name is saved on the device and synced to your account.
a.hi: Latest version me update karo — purane build me naam restart pe kho jaata tha. Naye version me naam device pe save hota hai aur account se sync hota hai.

a.en: Check your spam folder too, and wait a minute before tapping Resend. Codes can take up to a minute to arrive.
a.hi: Spam folder bhi dekho, aur Resend dabane se pehle ek minute ruko. Code aane me ek minute tak lag sakta hai.

a.en: Open your profile, tap Link phone, and give the missed call shown. Your number is marked verified automatically within a minute.
a.hi: Profile kholo, Link phone dabao, aur dikhaya gaya number pe missed call do. Ek minute me number automatically verified ho jaayega.

a.en: Both devices need internet. If it drifts, tap Sync in the room — the player jumps back to the host. The host controls play and pause.
a.hi: Dono devices me internet chahiye. Sync toot jaye to room me Sync dabao — player host ke paas wapas aa jaayega. Play-pause host ke haath me hai.

a.en: Allow microphone permission when asked. Voice only works inside a Watch Together room, and the room owner must have voice on.
a.hi: Puche jaane pe microphone permission do. Voice sirf Watch Together room me chalta hai, aur room owner ne voice on kiya hona chahiye.

a.en: If one song fails, tap it again — the app tries another source automatically. Offline songs play from your downloads first.
a.hi: Ek gaana fail ho to dobara tap karo — app khud doosra source try karta hai. Offline gaane pehle downloads se chalte hain.

a.en: Type the full song name with the artist for the best match. If a result is still wrong, tap it and use the report option.
a.hi: Best match ke liye poora gaana naam artist ke saath likho. Phir bhi galat ho to us pe tap karke report option use karo.

a.en: Open Settings → Addons → Store and add the ones you want. They install instantly; no restart needed.
a.hi: Settings → Addons → Store kholo aur jo chahiye add karo. Turant install ho jaate hain, restart ki zaroorat nahi.

a.en: Open Settings → Updates → Check for updates. If nothing shows, you already have the newest version.
a.hi: Settings → Updates → Check for updates kholo. Kuch na dikhe to aapke paas already newest version hai.

a.en: Open Downloads and remove what you have watched, or use Settings → Storage → Clear image cache. Downloads stop when free space is very low.
a.hi: Downloads kholo aur dekh liye items hata do, ya Settings → Storage → Clear image cache use karo. Space bahut kam ho to download ruk jaata hai.

a.en: The 18+ section needs your age confirmed in Settings → Content. It is hidden by default for safety.
a.hi: 18+ section ke liye Settings → Content me age confirm karni hoti hai. Safety ke liye ye by default hidden hai.

a.en: Open Settings → Playback and set a lower streaming quality, and turn on Data saver. That cuts data use a lot.
a.hi: Settings → Playback me kam streaming quality set karo, aur Data saver on karo. Isse data kaafi bachta hai.

a.en: Continue Watching syncs to your account after you sign in on the device. Play at least a minute of a title, then it appears.
a.hi: Continue Watching account se sync hota hai jab aap device pe sign in karte ho. Kisi title ka kam se kam ek minute chalao, phir dikh jaayega.

a.en: Close other apps, then in Settings → Storage use Clear image cache. If it still lags, restart the app once.
a.hi: Baaki apps band karo, phir Settings → Storage me Clear image cache use karo. Phir bhi lag ho to app ek baar restart karo.

a.en: Update to the latest version first — most crashes are already fixed. If it still happens, send a report from Settings → Help so we can see what went wrong.
a.hi: Pehle latest version me update karo — zyadatar crashes fix ho chuke hain. Phir bhi ho to Settings → Help se report bhejo, taaki hum dekh sakein.

a.en: Turn P2P off in Settings → Playback if a torrent source hangs, or pick a different source. P2P needs more open network ports.
a.hi: Torrent source hang ho to Settings → Playback me P2P off karo, ya doosra source chuno. P2P ko zyada open network ports chahiye.
